input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data-ownership article. Deliverables are referenced only in Kubient's warranties (p0033, p0040, where Kubient is stated to own the "products delivered hereunder"), and the sole licence to us (p0002) is a "limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license" to the Auction Platform that is expressly revoked on termination (p0021). There is therefore no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify or sublicense deliverables, and no limitation on Kubient's use of AP Content, Requests or other AP data. That fails the fallback position on material terms, so we insert a single short paragraph at fallback level: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform; we take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables (other than the Auction Platform, so paragraph 4(c) is not contradicted); and any Kubient licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no rights in deliverables or in our data, and the only licence to us (paragraph 2) is limited and revocable. We have added a short provision at our fallback position: Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for our business, and any Kubient licence in our content and data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

ops.text: Kubient retains ownership of its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform. Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense, for Customer's business, all deliverables provided by Kubient hereunder other than the Auction Platform. Any license granted to Kubient in the Content, Requests, and any other data or materials belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is limited to processing the same solely to provide the Services.
